# The mirror fixtures

The envelope a mirrored source pushes (`tenko_core::ir::MirrorSnapshot`, `docs/plans/windows-takeover-plan.md` sections 3.1 and 3.4, ADR 0033), for the fictitious domain `corp.example.test`. `tests/mirror_model.rs` builds these files from the types and holds them to them byte for byte; their field names, loss codes and location columns are those the exporter of `deploy/windows/mirror/` writes. The exporter's own output is `deploy/windows/mirror/tests/fixtures/expected-snapshot.json` and `fixtures/lab-dc1/expected-snapshot.json`, which its Pester suites produce from recorded cmdlet output and `crates/tenko-migrate/tests/mirror_service.rs` decodes, stores and diffs.

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `snapshot.json` | Sequence 1, taken at `2026-11-01T08:00:00Z` by `dc1.corp.example.test`: one active scope `192.0.2.0/24` (pool `.100` to `.199`, exclusion `.100` to `.109`, lease time eight days), thirty reservations at `.10` to `.39` named in every way of section 2.9, options at the server, scope and reservation level, the server-level and the scope's DDNS settings, sixty leases (forty-eight pool leases at `.110` to `.157`: sixteen `LAPTOP-NN` and sixteen `desk-NN` names keyed by a MAC address, sixteen `phone-NN` names keyed by an RFC 4361 identifier; ten leases of the reservations with a bare name; two declined addresses at `.158` and `.159`), and a loss report with one policy, one filter, one superscope and one lease in another state |
| `snapshot-inactive.json` | The same with the scope inactive, at sequence 2 and one minute later: the push the takeover waits for (section 2.7, step 2) |
| `snapshot-partner.json` | The failover partner `dc2.corp.example.test` of the same domain (section 2.15): without the reservation `192.0.2.39` (made on `dc1` only), with the scope's option 42 set to `192.0.2.6` (changed on `dc2` only), without the lease of `192.0.2.157` (known to `dc1` only), with the lease of `192.0.2.110` ending an hour earlier, and with `192.0.2.111` held by the client `00:00:5e:00:53:7f` (a lease conflict) |
| `snapshot-partner-inactive.json` | The partner's view with the scope inactive, at sequence 2 |

Documentation data only (RFC 5737 addresses, RFC 7042 MAC addresses `00:00:5e:00:53:xx`, names under `.test`). Regenerate them with `TENKO_REGENERATE_FIXTURES=1 cargo test -p tenko-core --test mirror_model` and review the diff: a change here is a change of the contract. The AD zones that go with the snapshot are `crates/tenko-dns/tests/fixtures/ad-zones/`, derived from it.
